question: Name the Indian music composer of songs for the film 'Slumdog Millionare'.
solution:
The correct answer is __**AR Rahman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **AR Rahman** is a globally renowned Indian music composer, singer, and music producer known for his exceptional contributions to music across various genres.
 
• The movie **‘Slumdog Millionaire’**, directed by Danny Boyle, featured a soundtrack composed by **AR Rahman**. The music played a pivotal role in portraying the emotions and essence of the film.
 
• AR Rahman won two **Academy Awards** (Oscars) in **2009** for his work on the film’s music. He received awards for **Best Original Score** and **Best Original Song** for "Jai Ho."
 
• The song "Jai Ho" gained international recognition and was celebrated worldwide for its fusion of Indian and Western musical elements, showcasing Rahman’s versatility.
 
• **AR Rahman’s contribution** to the music industry has earned him global acclaim, including numerous national and international awards like Grammy Awards, BAFTA Awards, and Golden Globe Awards.
 
• His music is known for its unique blend of Indian classical music with electronic, orchestral, and world music, making him a pioneer in the field of music composition.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is AR Rahman.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **AR Rahman’s Early Life and Career:**

 
 
• **AR Rahman** was born on **January 6, 1967**, in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. His birth name was **A.S. Dileep Kumar**, which he later changed after converting to Islam.
 
• He started his career in the Tamil film industry and gained recognition with his work in **Mani Ratnam’s film ‘Roja’** (1992), which marked his debut as a music composer.
 
 
 
• **Achievements and Awards:**
 
 
• His music has been featured in numerous acclaimed films, including **‘Dil Se,’ ‘Taal,’ ‘Lagaan,’** and **‘Rockstar.’**
 
 
 
• **Impact of ‘Slumdog Millionaire’:**
 
 
• The song **"Jai Ho"** became a cultural phenomenon and was adapted in various versions, including a popular collaboration with the Pussycat Dolls.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Works:**
 
 
• He established his own music studio, **Panchathan Record Inn**, in Chennai, which is one of the most advanced recording studios in India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Characteristics of Other Options:**

 
 
• **Pritam Chakraborty:** A Bollywood music composer famous for chartbusters in films like **‘Barfi!’** and **‘Ae Dil Hai Mushkil,’** but he was not associated with ‘Slumdog Millionaire.’
 
• **Santosh Narayanan:** A Tamil music composer recognized for his work in films like **‘Kabali’** and **‘Kaala,’** but he was not involved in the soundtrack of ‘Slumdog Millionaire.’
